description: List the files attached to every campaign of the caller's organization, newest first and at most 500, as the Files pane of the web app's settings shows them: each file's id, filename, contentType, kind (data, document, image, or text), byteSize, createdAt, uploader (the name of the user who uploaded it, or null once that account is deleted), and the campaignId and campaignName it is attached to. Returns no file contents. Needs a credential.
name: list_files
title: List files
